decisive_items: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques present in:- Bilateral submammary folds- Intergluteal cleft- Under the abdominal apron- Ulcers of the bilateral genitocrural folds- Vulvar edema
Family history notable for son with similar condition
Superficial and deep granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate
response.rationale: The clinical presentation of painful intertriginous wounds and characteristic skin lesions, along with a family history of a similar condition, supports the diagnosis of hidradenitis suppurativa. While granulomatous dermatitis is also a possible diagnosis, the presence of linear, moist, and eroded plaques in intertriginous areas is more consistent with hidradenitis suppurativa.

rejected.why: Negative laboratory tests for infectious agents make granuloma inguinale less likely
Unremarkable colonoscopy results and lack of gastrointestinal symptoms make Crohn's disease less likely
